IES LM-63 profiles as luminaire makers ship them, for `ies_test.cpp`, written by hand:

- `downlight_quadrant.ies`: LM-63-2002, type C, one quadrant (0 to 90 degree planes) of five vertical angles, ballast factor 0.5, its tilt in the file `lamp.tilt` beside it (a vertical lamp: 1, 0.9 and 0.8 at 0, 45 and 90 degrees).
- `floodlight_type_b.ies`: LM-63-1995, type B, comma separated with a row broken across lines, candela multiplier 2, its tilt included (a lamp horizontal along x).
